tbesh_html:
1) flesh, food, body, near kin, near kinswoman
1a) flesh
1a1) as food
1a2) for physical power (fig)
1b) flesh relation, blood relation
1c) self
Also means: sha.a.rah (שַׁאֲרָה "kinswomen" H7608)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: flesh (as swelling out), as living or forfood; generally food of any kind; figuratively, kindred by blood
strongs_1890.kjv_def: body, flesh, food, (near) kin(-sman, -swoman), near (nigh) (of kin).
